name: bfs
description: Breadth-first search: single-source hop distances over a 1M-node graph (level-synchronous).

output_parser.comment: Each line is '<index>\t<cost>'; integer hop distances (-1 if unreachable), compared exactly.

tolerance.comment: Integer hop distances — exact match required (source forced to node 0).

build.comment: Integer math; no FMA concerns, so correctness and perf builds are identical.
